title: Let an AI agent make music, art and 3D with Infinite's headless engine
description: Infinite's headless engine lets an AI agent such as Claude write a text patch, check it, listen to it and render music, pictures and 3D from the command line.

title: Field: write a short kernel and let the node decide where it runs
description: Field is the language built into Infinite. One kernel can become a shader, a geometry deformer or an audio effect, depending on the node it lives in.

title: A free TouchDesigner alternative for audio-reactive visuals?
description: An honest look at where Infinite fits next to TouchDesigner for audio-reactive visuals and VJ work, and where TouchDesigner is still the better choice.

title: Infinite v0.6 benchmarks: where it is fast and where it is not
description: Infinite benchmarks on a base MacBook Air M2 against Blender, Vital, Serum 2 and popular DAWs, with the results published, including where Infinite is slower.

title: Make your first audio-reactive visual in Infinite
description: A beginner walkthrough from a free template to a shape that moves with your music, using the Audio Analyze node and a single cable.

title: Modulate any VST3 or AU plugin with LFOs, audio and visuals
description: Load a third-party plugin into Infinite and drive its parameters from an LFO, an envelope follower or something moving on screen.

title: Free motion tracking for music and visuals in Infinite
description: Hand Track, Face Track and Pose Track turn a camera or picture into modulators, so a pinch, a smile or a raised arm can drive any parameter in your patch.

title: One graph for sound and pictures: how Infinite keeps them in step
description: Infinite runs a pull-based audio graph and a GPU texture pipeline off one BPM transport, so audio can drive visuals and visuals can drive audio.

title: Render video and audio from a text file with no window open
description: Infinite's headless mode turns a plain-text patch into stills, video and a loudness report from the command line. Here is the five-minute workflow.
